MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  date_diff('year', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-')), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS age
WHERE ((age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University'))
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-'))) - CASE
    WHEN date_part('month', DATE(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-'))) > 10

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, collect(t.team_name) AS teams,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date
WITH p, teams,
  2026 - date_part('year', birth_date) - CASE
    WHEN date_part('month', birth_date) > 10
      OR (date_part('month', birth_date) = 10 AND date_part('day', birth_date) > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (p.college = 'Temple University' AND 'Detroit Pistons' IN teams)
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
